description: Research other software products' affiliate programs — the same list as risetive.com/affiliates: each program's commission rate, for how long it pays (lifetime, a number of months, every renewal or once), cookie days, what one customer on the cheapest monthly plan earns the referrer each month, the product's monthly visits and the official program page. Without a niche it reads the whole list, best-paying first; with a niche slug (from risetive_find_competitors or risetive_get_product_profile) it reads that niche. Niches are not listed. Without an account: today's 5 programs, a different batch each day, and no niche. A free Risetive account: today's 10, and a niche's 2 lowest commission rates. Neither gets the 10 that pay the most per customer. Risetive Pro ($19/year): every program, 50 at a time (pass nextOffset as offset), and every program in a niche. When a list is cut, upgrade says how many more there are.

niche.description: Niche slug as returned by risetive_find_competitors or risetive_get_product_profile, or in a niche URL, e.g. "ai-photo-and-image-editors".

offset.description: Risetive Pro only: where the next page of the whole list starts; pass nextOffset from the last answer.

name: risetive_list_affiliate_programs
title: List software affiliate programs
